sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You are likely to have differences with your parents in the early hours of the day. Ganesha urge you not to quarrel or confront them. Do not retaliate in any way. Act decent and discreet. Respect their views, wishes and sentiments. Be careful. You may have health problems later in the day. If your health does deteriorate, do not take things casually. Don’t think twice. Go consult a medical specialist without delay.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: A lot of activity could occur at home today, Taurus. Perhaps you will have visitors or do some work on the house. Your intuition is particularly strong right now, and you could pick up too much of the thoughts and feelings of others, even strangers. You will probably be most in tune with your family. Take care to guard your thoughts. Today you might find that whatever you think of could actually manifest.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Allow your troubles to burn away, and rise like a phoenix from the ashes. The Sagittarius Moon and Chiron form an invigorating aspect, darling Taurus, providing you with the fire necessary to release what does not serve you. Work with positive mantras as the morning unfolds, focusing on transformation, empowerment, and cleansing. You'll feel lighter and spiritually fulfilled after Luna enters Capricorn this afternoon, bringing you closer to the divine powers that watch over you each day. Your imagination grows stronger once Neptune stirs later today, and prolonged meditation sessions can lead to inspired ideas or personal epiphanies. Share what you discover with someone you trust while Mercury rx activates tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Get involved in activities that are exciting and keep you relaxed. Be careful not to get roped into dubious financial deals. For some- a new arrival in the family brings in moments for celebration and party. Wedding bells for some while others will find romance to keep them in high spirits. Today you will have the stamina and the know-how to raise your earning power. Your ability to help those in need will bring you respect. Your spouse will remind you the time of your teenage today along with some notorious stuff.

readings.text: It’s in your hand to safeguard your professional image till afternoon. Someone may behave in a very bizarre way at the office. You will be looking for the valuable outputs you are giving. In short, money and work may be compared, says Ganesha.

Your spirit feels caged. You feel like your work is suffocating you in some way. Make a conscious effort to unleash yourself. Talk to your employers honestly about what your needs are and how they can be better met. Work together as a team.

readings.text: During first half of the day, you are not going to be money conscious. You will be dealing with worldly affairs in such a way that you will hardly have any time to think about money matters.

Career activity brings excitement and drama but also a bit of unpredictability this week. Ideas are flying, but you need to monetize one before moving on to the next lest you find yourself with decreased cash flow. A lot is changing there, requiring you to be diplomatic with your attention at this time.

bits.t: Be careful not to get roped into dubious financial deals.

readings.text: Ganesha feels that the day is going to keep you busy with professional and personal activities so you will be investing lot of energy in everything that you deal with. As the day progresses, you will need more and more energy.

You may have learned ways to ignore your need for balance - putting your finger on these will be part of the challenge in creating a structure that gives you more of it. Have you considered what foods make you feel light yet satisfied, energized and happy? We all have specific foods that work best in our system, but too few of us are conscientious enough to notice what they are. Today's planetary configuration encourages you to examine your personal habits.

bits.t: You may have health problems later in the day.
If your health does deteriorate, do not take things casually.

lucky.remedy: Prepare dessert (kheer) made of milk, sugar and rice and distribute it among young girls for excellent financial benefits

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Friends are seeing you with a new level of respect. Your hard work is paying off.
